This meticulously crafted peshwas ensemble exudes elegance through its captivating ice blue tissue. This outfit embodice luxury and refinement.

9286460768412.title: SILK DAWN – 1PC RAWSILK PRET
9286460768412.description:
PRODUCT DETAILS    

SHIRT
STYLE LONG KURTA (RAWSILK)
Heavy embroidered chicken kari front
Embroidered borders on panels
Embroidered borders on hemline
Embroidered and hand embellished motifs on shoulders
Hand embellished button details on neckline
Loop buttons on side slits
Heavy embroidered chicken kari sleeves

STYLE TIP
Rendered in a greyish blue rawsilk base, this elongated shirt is defined by a fully embroidered chicken Kari front featuring intricate vertical patterns. The design is anchored by substantial horizontal embroidered borders across the lower hemline, while the shoulders are highlighted with distinct, crystal-embellished motifs for a refined contrast. A classic button placket centers the shirt, mirrored by prominent button detailing that cleanly traces the high side slits and sleeve cuffs.

9380128194716.title: SILVER MIST – 1PC Velvet PRET
9380128194716.description:
PRODUCT DETAILS    

SHIRT
STYLE LONG KAFTAN (Velvet)
Velvet kaftan
Heavy Embroidered Front
Heavy Embroidered Pannels
Heavy Embroidered Sleeves 


STYLE TIP
Rendered in a beautiful muted silver-grey hue, this elegant ensemble features delicate floral embroidery with soft blush accents and charming handcrafted tassel details along the neckline. The flowing silhouette and intricate botanical motifs create a dreamy, feminine winter look.

8294324797596.title: SIRAN – 3PC ZARI JAMAWAR & NET WEDDING FESTIVE PRET
8294324797596.description:
Product Details

SHIRT
STYLE LONG A-LINE SHIRT (ZARI JAMAWAR)
Embroidered and embellished front with tilla, zardozi work,crystals and resham 
Zari work embellished neckline
Fitted sleeves

SHARARA
Dyed khadi lawn and zari jamawar flared lehnga

DUPATTA
 Net dupata with embroidered border finishings

STYLE TIP
This elegant greyish blue alluring look from ‘Tappe’ features a heavily embroidered and hand embellished shirt on a zari jamawar base featuring details of zardozi, resham and crystal work. It comes with same jamawar and khadi silk sharara. It is paired by a contrasting peachy net dupatta finished with embroidered tilla and resham borders that captures the essence of timeless Punjabi spirit—with nostalgia stitched into every detail and charm that speaks to every heart.

Size & Fit:
Model Height: 5’8”
Model Wears: Small

Note: Delivery after 14th November

A sophisticated blend of bold colour, intricate embroidery and refined embellishment, perfect for festive occasions.
